# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Related Work

- Requirement(s):
- Issue(s):
- UX / design reference:

## Type of Change

- [ ] Product / feature
- [ ] UX / design
- [ ] Accessibility
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Security / privacy
- [ ] SEO / discoverability
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Infrastructure / deployment

## Verification

Mark irrelevant checks as **N/A** rather than silently skipping them.

### Product

- [ ] Change satisfies its acceptance criteria
- [ ] Relevant requirements/documentation are updated
- [ ] Error, empty, loading and success states are handled where applicable

### Design / Responsive

- [ ] Matches the approved design or documents intentional differences
- [ ] Uses existing tokens/components where appropriate
- [ ] Mobile and desktop behaviour checked
- [ ] Long/unusual content checked where relevant

### Accessibility

- [ ] Semantic structure reviewed
- [ ] Keyboard interaction checked
- [ ] Focus behaviour checked
- [ ] Accessible names/labels checked
- [ ] Contrast checked where visual values changed
- [ ] Automated accessibility findings reviewed where applicable

### Engineering

- [ ] Tests added/updated where they improve confidence
- [ ] Existing tests pass
- [ ] Validation and error handling reviewed
- [ ] Logging does not expose sensitive information
- [ ] No unnecessary dependencies or complexity introduced

### Security / Privacy

- [ ] Authentication/authorisation implications reviewed
- [ ] Input/output handling reviewed
- [ ] CSRF/session/cookie implications reviewed where applicable
- [ ] Personal-data implications reviewed
- [ ] Secrets are not committed or exposed

### Performance / SEO

- [ ] Performance impact considered
- [ ] Images/assets optimised where relevant
- [ ] Metadata/canonical/structured-data implications reviewed where relevant

## Evidence

Add screenshots, test output, Lighthouse/axe results or other evidence when useful.
